summary.headline: Intel's PC warning hits HPQ; ILMN down 16%; PLTR, TEAM, ZS face earnings risk
summary.summary: Holdings first: HPQ is the clearest threat, with Intel's warning of prolonged PC weakness hitting it premarket Oct 30 alongside heavy short volume and insider selling, though the size of the drop is unreported. ILMN fell about 16% after Q3 despite a raised full-year guide, and reports conflict on whether revenue beat or missed, so check the print before deciding. ZS slid 3-8% in a security-sector selloff after Fortinet's results, and PLTR, TEAM and ZS all carry earnings binary risk. The one bullish holding is ACN, with insider cluster buying and rising estimates, though the federal awards spike is unverified and some insiders are selling. Candidates AMD, MU, MRVL and FTNT all lean cautious, with no clean entries; the MRVL move rests on an unconfirmed Lumentum deal report.
actions: Check HPQ premarket price and size; decide whether to cut or hold through Intel's PC read-through.
Pull ILMN Q3 revenue vs consensus to resolve conflicting headlines before choosing hold or exit.
Size PLTR, TEAM and ZS ahead of earnings; TEAM options imply a ~13% move.
